Package com.composum.platform.models.annotations

Annotations for use with Sling-Models in conjunction with Composum models, as well as relevant interfaces etc.
Since:
09/2017
Author:
Hans-Peter Stoerr
  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    DetermineResourceStategy
    Strategy to determine the resource the properties of the model should be initialized from.
    InternationalizationStrategy
    A strategy to get property values, possibly internationalized.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    DescendantPath
    Selects a descendant resource for a BeanContext, SlingHttpServletRequest (or Resource) as a @Via while keeping the type and other values except the resource.
    DetermineResourceStategy.OriginalResourceStrategy
    Default: just returns the original resource unchanged.
    InternationalizationStrategy.I18NFOLDER
    Default internationalization strategy used in Composum Pages: uses ResourceHandle.getInherited(String, Class) to retrieve inherited values and retrieves internationalized properties from locale dependent folders below i18n/ at the current resource.
    InternationalizationStrategy.NONE
    No internationalization - just uses the attributes.
    InternationalizationStrategy.USEDEFAULT
    Signifies the use of a default InternationalizationStrategy - for use as "no value" in annotations.
  • Annotation Types Summary 
    Annotation Type Description
    Property
    Annotation to be used on either methods, fields or constructor parameter to let Sling Models inject a value from the ValueMap of a subpath of the current resource.
    PropertyDefaults
    Defines some defaults that apply to a Model class, mostly used in conjunction with Property.
    PropertyDetermineResourceStrategy
    Defines some defaults that apply to a Model class, mostly used in conjunction with Property.
